# v0.8.0b2 — Easier vehicle setup and a separate debug tab

Beta of the integration and app. **0.6.1 remains stable.**

Changes compared with 0.8.0b1:

- **Plug & Charge on the wallbox:** enable it with its own switch under
  Configuration. Each vehicle's permission stays in its profile. Existing
  settings are preserved; disabling does not resume charging.
- **Guided vehicle setup:** missing profiles and detection sources lead to the
  relevant setup steps. Dialogs identify the selected car and offer supported
  sources. Removing charge-level use is clearly distinguished from setting the
  current percentage target to zero.
- **Dedicated app debug tab:** decoded Modbus communication lives in
  **Web UI → Debug log**, beside **Connection**. Unsaved settings survive tab
  changes. Capture stays temporary and in memory, without extra database load.

Keep your existing HA entry and app data. When updating both components, update
the app to **0.8.0b2 through #apps-beta first**, wait for initialization, then
update the integration. Ordinary service connections still require **API 2 and
service 0.6.1 or newer**; Plug & Charge needs **app 0.8.0b1 or newer**.
**#apps stays on stable 0.6.1.** Direct USB/LAN needs no app.
